menu.title: C A R O M I N E
menu.tagline: Nurmijarvi, winter. Build the car. Survive.
prompt.car: E: get in the car   T: workshop
obj.build: Build the car: install the engine + gearbox in the garage shed (T next to the car)
obj.run: Get it running: battery, plugs, fuel filter, coolant, fuel... then press I
obj.tyres: Winter is here: buy and fit winter tyres (auto parts shop, workshop)
obj.inspect: Pass the katsastus (inspection station, village) - see the manual for what they check
obj.helsinki: Drive south to Helsinki and settle things with the Director (marker on the south edge)
obj.free: Free roam. The Director is dead. Take gigs, upgrade the car, or drive off into the Finnish sunset.
toast.freezing: You're freezing! Get warm: car heater, sauna, coffee.
toast.no_battery: Nothing happens. There is no battery.
toast.dead_battery: Nothing happens. The battery is dead. (Charge it in the workshop: T)
toast.weak_battery: click-click-click... the battery is too weak.
toast.no_engine: The starter spins freely... there is no engine!
toast.no_fuel: Cranks and cranks... out of fuel.
toast.frozen: Cranks, coughs, won't catch. Fuel line frozen? (Dry gas helps)
toast.fouled: Cranks but won't catch. The spark plugs are fouled.
home.phone: Pick up the phone: agency gigs
